categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Has the Build system label and modifies compiler release flags in depends host files for Linux and Windows.
categories.rationale: Adds compiler fortification flags (_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3 and -fstack-clash-protection) to depends release builds for Linux and Windows. This provides valuable defense-in-depth against memory corruption for bundled dependencies like SQLite and ZeroMQ, though it is non-urgent and reasonably deferrable.
